entities.name: Topa
entities.description: One of the Inner Three nations of Bant on Alara, an open savannah famed for caravans and master merchants.

entities.name: Leotau
entities.description: Wild feline mounts that live in Topa and attack Valeron's horse herds.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: Neighboring nation of Bant with horse herds.

entities.name: Mortar
entities.description: Caste of scribes, accountants, merchants and traders, large in Topa.

entities.name: Sighted
entities.description: Visionary caste consulted by the Blessed.

entities.name: Unbeholden
entities.description: Caste Topa's monks encourage to find their place in society.

events.summary: Leotau often attack Valeron's horse herds, keeping relations strained.
events.quote: The leotau often attack Valeron 's horse herds

relations.note: It is one of the Inner Three nations of Bant.
relations.quote: Topa is one of the Inner Three nations of Bant on Alara

relations.note: The small Blessed caste rules Topa.
relations.quote: The small Blessed caste that rules Topa
